tasks.title: Core flow: auto-generate first popup with copy-existing logic
tasks.description: Upgrade apps/web/src/app/onboarding/generate-popup/page.tsx significantly. Logic: (1) Read asmos_analyze_result from sessionStorage — includes storeName, industry, brandColor, popup.found, popup.description. (2) If popup.found=true: use popup.description (AI-detected text) to generate Variant A that copies the existing popup's offer/headline/style as closely as possible. Add a second variant (Variant B) with Asmos-improved copy — stronger headline, clearer CTA. Label them 'Your current popup (control)' and 'Asmos variant'. (3) If popup.found=false: generate from cold start using brandColor + industry. Generate 2 variants with meaningfully different hypotheses (different headline angle, different CTA, different offer framing). (4) The generated popup should use the widget v2 design quality — not a bland placeholder. Use the campaign creation API correctly. (5) Show a step-by-step generation progress UI (not just a spinner) — 'Analyzing your brand...', 'Writing headline variants...', 'Building popup design...', 'Setting up A/B test...'. Commit: feat: generate-popup — copy-existing logic, 2-variant generation, progress UI

tasks.title: Campaign detail — variant manager + Successive Halving knockout bracket
tasks.description: Match reference screenshots 17, 18, 19. This is the core differentiator UI. (1) apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/campaigns/[id]/page.tsx — full campaign detail with tabs: Overview, Variants, Analytics, Insights. (2) Variant Manager (VariantManager.tsx) — list of variants with live stats (impressions, conversion rate, traffic %), ability to add new variant, pause/resume individual variants. (3) Knockout Bracket (KnockoutBracket.tsx) — implement Successive Halving visualization: variants start in round 1, losers get eliminated each round (shown grayed out with X), survivors advance. Use real variant performance data from the DB to determine bracket state. The bracket should be a proper visual bracket layout — not a list. Algorithm context: Thompson Sampling drives traffic allocation (more traffic to higher-performing variants), Successive Halving drives elimination rounds. Show each variant's win probability % on its bracket card. (4) InsightsPanel.tsx — AI-written plain-English explanation of what's happening ('Variant B is winning because its headline is more specific to new visitors. Recommend letting it run 48 more hours to reach statistical significance.'). Use /api/campaigns/[id]/chat or a new /api/campaigns/[id]/insights route. (5) PerformanceTable.tsx and AnalyticsTab.tsx — real charts, not placeholders. Commit per sub-component.
